why: The exact conflation issue #320 forbids: resolving controller rumble from the DEVICE vibration capability. A phone with `navigator.vibrate` and no pad would report rumble available; a desktop pad with an actuator and no `navigator.vibrate` would report none. Killed by effective-settings.test.ts's 'gates each on its OWN capability' and loop.test.ts's 'keeps controller rumble on its OWN capability', both of which set exactly one capability in each direction so a resolver reading the wrong one has to get a row wrong. 7 of 385 across the two declared files.
